# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

He is an independent, mischievous boy with a swaggering and impertinent manner. Initially holding a disdainful attitude toward female teachers, he shows his defiance through sullenness, mockery, and covert pranks rather than outright disobedience. However, he also proves to be a boy who can acknowledge and respect strength or firm discipline when he encounters it.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P24](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0024), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## History

Anthony Pye was taken in by his aunt and uncle, Mr. and Mrs. George Pye, and enrolled at Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. Holding the view that female teachers were useless, he maintained a sullen and mocking attitude toward Anne. On a particularly stressful day at school, he placed a live mouse in Anne's desk; when confronted, he insolently admitted his guilt, prompting Anne to lose her temper and whip him with a pointer. Surprising everyone, the punishment won Anthony's respect, as he declared the whipping was as good as a man's. Following this incident, he became helpful and polite to Anne, even defending her against other boys when she eventually announced her resignation.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
